apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk, sideload it
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

## What's new
- SGSR: give it its own sharpness setting rather than sharing FSR's
- SGSR: add the edge-direction variant, and reach 2.0 without a wider slider
- LSFG: re-check the DLL after an import rewrites it in place
- Fix LSFG DLL import verification to handle empty streams and improve file validation
- SGSR: credit CamilleLaVey in the feature's C++ entry point
- SGSR: name the sharpness slider after the upscaler it is driving
- SGSR: reach it from the in-game menu too
- GS: add SGSR upscaling (Qualcomm Snapdragon Game Super Resolution 1)
- Thermals: the no-reading sentinel was a positive number
- Second screen: size the cover cell against the display, not the artwork
- Second screen: give the cover a real box, say which RA mode is active
- Second screen: fit the cover, scroll the panel, mark hardcore vs casual
- Second screen: append the new tiles to existing layouts, not just pristine ones
- Second screen: cover and RetroAchievements in the default layout
- Fix crash on launch: achievements polled with no VM
- Second screen: cover art and more of what RetroAchievements knows
- Fix theme changes not reaching the panel; collapsible editor toolbar
- Second screen and OSD: the rest of the batch
- Touch editor: the panel gets out of the way by itself
- Second screen: follow the app's theme, tile icons, thermals, backgrounds
- Second screen: pause that stays, even tiles; on-screen turbo (#619)

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260824...ab1df6fdd6ec663dfab5127497c9506c183b0d6d
